levels.surface: أحمد بن الفرات أبو مسعود الرازي

notes: «- المعنى -» is a gloss, left out

«أن حذيفة أم الناس» opens the scene; Hudhayfa then answers («قال بلى قد ذكرت»), so he speaks inside the narrator's story and is the last link (owner ruling 5). This is a judgement on a narrated encounter, not a transmitted «حدثه», so it is flagged here rather than in needs_ruling
